ns2:course.label: Trial Advocacy
ns2:course.description: Examination of the problems of advocacy and tactics at the trial level. Students engage in all aspects of actual trial work, including witness preparation, opening and closing statements, direct and cross examination, and jury instructions; culminates in student conduct of a full jury trial in late spring; demonstrations are conducted by staff and visiting judges and practitioners. 2 to 3 graduate hours. 2 to 4 professional hours. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated, if topics vary.
